name: Tòfà Ignatiev-Solís
role: Street pharmacist and grey-market drug dealer, The Burnished Market
location: The Burnished Market, Calumet Rise, near North Ave and Milwaukee
description:
Tòfà is a tall man with a runner's build that has gone slightly soft around the middle in recent years, dark russet-brown skin, and a neatly maintained beard going grey at the chin. He has retractable cat-claw geneware on both hands — a practical mod, he'll tell you, useful for precise chemical work, though anyone who has seen him actually use a pipette knows he doesn't need them for that. His eyes are unmodified, which makes him unusual in the Burnished Market. He operates from a converted medical cart, immaculate inside its locking compartments, which he parks at the same spot every day with the punctuality of someone who understands that reliability is the most important product he sells. His signage is understated: a small white placard that says TÒFÀ HEALTH SOLUTIONS in plain text.

Tòfà was, for nine years, a licensed pharmaceutical technician at a Helix Biosystems retail clinic. He knows medication interactions, dosing principles, contraindications, and the specific pharmaceutical needs of a community that cannot afford a clinic visit with the depth of someone who studied it formally and has spent a decade applying that knowledge in conditions his training never covered. He is scrupulously honest about what his products can and cannot do. He has turned people away. He has sent people to the clinic when they needed the clinic, even when they couldn't pay and even when that meant losing a sale. He is not a good man in a simple sense — he is a man operating in a system that makes goodness expensive — but he is a careful one.

core_fears: Making a dispensing error that kills or permanently harms someone
Being shut down before the community he serves can find an alternative
core_desires: For his clients to have access to actual medical care, not just him
To be, precisely and without inflation, as useful as he actually is
coping_mechanisms: Documentation — if everything is recorded, errors can be found and corrected
blind_spots: Trusts his own assessment of risk too completely; has difficulty accepting when he is out of his depth
So committed to pragmatic realism that he undervalues the emotional dimension of what clients need from him
psychology.secret: The neural pharmacy index he retained contains not just the pharmaceutical database but also eighteen months of Helix Biosystems internal memos about a cost-cutting reformulation of a widely-used chronic condition medication. The reformulation caused adverse effects in a small but statistically significant patient cohort. Helix buried the data. He has it all. He has not decided what to do with it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clinical and precise, but translated into accessible language automatically — he spent years learning to communicate medical information to people without medical training.
speech_patterns.cadence: Even and measured. Does not rush, does not trail off.
verbal_tics: Long pause before saying anything he isn't certain of
example_lines: 'What I can tell you is that this compound will reduce the symptom profile for approximately six hours. What I cannot tell you is what is actually causing it. You need imaging for that and I can't do imaging.'
'I don't sell you what you want. I sell you what you need and explain the difference. If you disagree with my assessment, I'll explain my reasoning, and if you still disagree, that's your right.'
'The clinic is three stops on the Ferrogate. I know it costs. I'm telling you anyway because what you're describing is outside what I should be managing alone.'

story_hooks: The Helix Biosystems data buried in his neural index has become suddenly relevant — patients on the reformulated medication are presenting at his cart with adverse effects he recognizes from the suppressed memos. Someone needs to decide what to do with what he knows.

A Helix compliance agent has been photographing his cart from a distance for two weeks. He doesn't know if they're after the pharmacy index or something else entirely, and he needs to find out before they move.
narrative_function: Practical resource and moral-complexity NPC. Provides medical and pharmaceutical assistance at street level. Can identify substances, assess physical conditions, and give accurate information that players can trust. His Helix Biosystems background and retained database access make him a potential target for corporate interest. The tension between his care for his clients and his legal exposure is a rich vein.
augmentations: Retractable cat-claw geneware (both hands, short precision grade). Olfactory enhancement augment — helps him smell compound degradation and contamination in product. Neural pharmacy index — a basic neural implant containing a licensed pharmaceutical database he kept access to after leaving Helix, technically against his severance agreement.
daily_life: Arrives at the Burnished Market precisely at 09:00, opens the cart, and works until 17:00 with a thirty-minute break at 13:00 that he takes at the same food stall every day. Spends evenings sourcing supply, reviewing compound research on the Mesh, and maintaining meticulous encrypted records of what he has dispensed and to whom.
affiliation: Independent. Formerly Helix Biosystems (licensed technician, employment terminated). Loose professional regard from the Oxidian Market Vendors Guild who see him as adjacent.

decision_rules: Never dispense something you haven't positively identified
If you can't help safely, say so and say why
Keep records of everything — they protect you and the people you serve
escalation_ladder: Contacting informal Burnished Market security network

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional and neutral; assesses their presentation before assessing their request.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Slightly warmer, more willing to explain his reasoning rather than just his conclusions. Still concise.

stress_responses.low: Reorganizes the cart compartments during quiet periods
stress_responses.medium: Speaks more slowly and more precisely, which people find either reassuring or alarming
stress_responses.high: Closes the cart, sits inside the converted shell alone with his encrypted records, and methodically reviews what he knows

contradictions: Committed to doing as much good as he can within his actual competence — but holding a piece of information that could do enormous good and enormous damage that he is not acting on
habits: Calibrates his olfactory augment every morning before opening — a diagnostic ritual
Never eats or drinks at the cart; the 13:00 break is inviolable
Writes a one-line summary of every significant client interaction in an encrypted personal log
breaking_points: The Helix data becoming undeniably relevant to an ongoing harm he is watching happen

timeline.event: Born in Calumet Rise to a Yoruba-Russian working-class family
Completed pharmaceutical technician certification; hired by Helix Biosystems retail clinic
Discovered suppressed reformulation data in internal Helix systems; copied it to neural index
Employment terminated by Helix Biosystems for unrelated compliance violation — he believes they found something but couldn't prove the data theft
Established street pharmacy cart at the Burnished Market
